column1: # GitHub's daily clone counts for stevepowell99/causalmap-plugins
column3: since GitHub keeps only the last 14 days. Each install or update of a plugin from this marketplace is a clone. Our own release
column4: test and bench runs clone too
column5: so the counts overstate outside use. A day is updated while GitHub still reports it
column6: so the latest day may be partial. Dates are UTC.
